text: いつでも　てがるに　みることが　できる　べんりな　ちず。

structure.jp: いつでも　てがるに
みることが　できる

patterns.name: 〜ことができる
patterns.span: みることが　できる
patterns.explanation: A plain verb followed by ことができる says that you are able to do it. みることが　できる = 'can look at'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: いつでも　てがるに　みることが　できる　べんりな　ちず
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing, like 'that...' in English. いつでも　てがるに　みることが　できる　べんりな　ちず = 'a handy map that you can easily look at any time'.

patterns.name: 〜に (adverb)
patterns.explanation: に after a describing word like てがる (easy, simple) turns it into a word saying how something is done. てがるに = 'easily'.
